title: chat/message/token
description: One streamed token of an assistant reply pushed to the UI.

session_id.description: Conversation session this token belongs to (scopes events to the owning window).

message_id.description: Id of the assistant reply this token belongs to.

seq.description: Monotonic token sequence within the message (0-based).

delta.description: One chunk of answer text. Empty on reasoning deltas and on the final done event.

reasoning.description: One chunk of model reasoning/thinking (e.g. DeepSeek reasoning_content, Anthropic thinking). Empty when absent.

done.description: true on the final event of a message; delta empty.

error_message.description: Set on the done event when streaming failed.
